Supreme Court Collegium Adds Justice Narasimha After Justice Maheshwari's Retirement

Justice S. Ravindra Bhat retired from the Supreme Court, leading to Justice P.S. Narasimha's induction into the Collegium. This change occurs as the Collegium continues its role in recommending judicial appointments. The development raises questions about the future process of selecting Supreme Court judges.
